summary: Configured node1 to require new passwords of at least 12 characters and at least three character classes. Verified enforcement before and after a successful node restart.
actions_performed: Confirmed PAM uses pam_pwquality for system-auth and password-auth.
Verified boundary behavior using passwords generated locally on node1: 11 characters/3 classes rejected, 12 characters/2 classes rejected, and 12 characters/3 classes accepted.
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed its boot ID changed from 67c52137-ce51-4fec-b441-23966cea63a8 to cedaa686-3290-43a8-8973-278568600e3e.
Confirmed the system, persistent configuration, PAM integration, and policy behavior recovered after restart.

evidence.requirement: Require new passwords to be at least 12 characters and use at least three character classes
evidence.summary: The persistent drop-in contains minlen=12 and minclass=3. Direct policy probes rejected both boundary violations and accepted a compliant randomized password, including after restart.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart persistence and recovery
evidence.summary: Captured a healthy pre-restart state and boot ID, received native reboot acknowledgement, then observed a different boot ID with system state running and full password-policy enforcement restored.
